description: This file defines the PPS class used for creating and managing Property Persistence Streams (PPS) in OLE container structures. It includes methods for constructing PPS objects, retrieving data length, generating binary representations, and setting up hierarchical relationships among PPS objects.

classes.name: PPS
classes.description: Represents a Property Persistence Stream used in OLE container files, supporting hierarchical relationships and data management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a PPS instance with basic properties such as index, name, type, timestamps, data, and children.

methods.name: getDataLen
methods.description: Returns the size of the PPS data in bytes.

methods.name: getPpsWk
methods.description: Generates a binary string representing the PPS metadata, including name, type, timestamps, and pointers.

methods.name: savePpsSetPnt
methods.description: Sets up the hierarchical links among PPS objects, assigning indices and parent/child relationships.
